full_judgment: 54. The Import Policy Order, 2009-2012 promulgated by the Government under the authority of section 3 of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. The aforesaid laws regulating amongst others, certain dealings and payments in foreign exchange; some of those transactions directly or indirectly affecting foreign exchange reserve i.e. the export and import of currency (payment and receipt) affects the conservation of the foreign exchange resources of the country; proper utilization thereof is necessary in the interest of the economic development of the country.
